title: Spanish openings · cumulative exploration
decisionProcess: Human review between generations; no automatic prompt mutation or selection
recommendation: Use Prompt 4 (Examples), temperature 1.1, as the parent for the next human-reviewed generation. The prior default-top-p/no-persona cell averaged 0.512 within-level cosine and at least 80% length fit at every level. Explicit top_p=0.8 averaged 0.545 with the same 80% floor, but reading exposes repetitive and awkward openings. top_p=1 lowers cosine to 0.442 while dropping the length-fit floor to 60% and introducing incoherent fragments. Keep the prior default condition as the control; carry explicit 0.8 as a reproducible sampling comparator. Neither is ready for production without improving grounding and testing continuation. Do not maximize letters/word or sentence length: they are descriptive proxies, not desirable outcomes by themselves.
